content: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg now owns an actual castle. Zuckerberg and his wife Priscilla Chan bought Strancally Castle and its 440-acre estate in Ireland “several weeks ago,” according to The Irish Times. While the exact price of the purchase is unclear, the family could have paid “anywhere between €20 million and €30 million” for the 16,000-square-foot castle, which was restored by its previous owners. “Mark and his family look forward to caring for this historic home and visiting when traveling to Ireland, where Meta maintains its international headquarters,” Brian Baker, a spokesperson for Zuckerberg, says in a statement to The Verge. The Irish Times says “it is understood” that Zuckerberg and Chan will still reside in the US. Strancally Castle was built around 1830 for a Tory MP. The castle’s previous owners were Michael Alen-Buckley, a co-founder of a private investment company, and his wife, Giancarla.  Zuckerberg also reportedly owns more than 11 properties in Palo Alto and properties in Florida, Washington, D.C., and Hawaii. Update, August 20th: Added statement from Baker.

chineseContent: Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格现在拥有一座真正的城堡。据《爱尔兰时报》报道，扎克伯格和他的妻子普里西拉·陈“几周前”购买了位于爱尔兰的斯特兰卡利城堡及其占地 440 英亩的庄园。虽然购买的具体价格尚不清楚，但该家族可能会为这座 16,000 平方英尺的城堡支付“2000 万至 3000 万欧元之间的价格”，该城堡由其前任主人修复。扎克伯格发言人布莱恩·贝克 (Brian Baker) 在给 The Verge 的一份声明中表示：“马克和他的家人期待着照顾这座历史悠久的住宅，并在前往爱尔兰（Meta 在那里设有其国际总部）时参观。” 《爱尔兰时报》称，“据了解”扎克伯格和陈仍将居住在美国。斯特兰卡利城堡 (Strancally Castle) 于 1830 年左右为一位保守党议员建造。这座城堡的前主人是一家私人投资公司的联合创始人迈克尔·艾伦-巴克利 (Michael Alen-Buckley) 和他的妻子吉安卡拉 (Giancarla)。  据报道，扎克伯格还在帕洛阿尔托以及佛罗里达州、华盛顿特区和夏威夷拥有超过 11 处房产。 8 月 20 日更新：添加了 Baker 的声明。
